UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's public profile and core information within the HarmonyAI dating application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. This is typically the Firebase Authentication UID.

profilePhotoUrl.description: URL to the user's profile photo stored in Firebase Storage.

bio.description: A short biographical description provided by the user.

gender.description: The user's gender identity (e.g., 'male', 'female', 'non-binary', 'prefer not to say').

dateOfBirth.description: The user's date of birth, used for age calculation.

location.description: The user's general location (e.g., city, state) for local matching.

isVerified.description: Indicates if the user's identity has been successfully verified. (Derived from verificationStatus).

verificationStatus.description: The current status of the user's identity verification process. (enum: 'not_verified', 'pending', 'verified', 'rejected').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

UserPersonality.title: UserPersonality
UserPersonality.description: Stores the personality and communication style analysis results for a user, derived from the AI interview feature.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserPersonality entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this personality analysis belongs to.

personalityType.description: AI-derived primary personality type or category.

communicationStyle.description: AI-derived description of the user's communication style.

keyTraits.description: An array of key personality traits identified by the AI.

lastAnalysisDate.description: Timestamp of the most recent AI personality analysis.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Represents a potential or confirmed match between two users, based on AI analysis and user interaction.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Match entity.

user1Id.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the first participant in the match.

user2Id.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the second participant in the match.

matchScore.description: A numerical score indicating the compatibility between user1 and user2, typically 0-100.

status.description: The status of the match from user1's perspective towards user2. (enum: 'pending', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'blocked').

user1ActionedAt.description: Timestamp when user1 last interacted with this match (e.g., liked or rejected).

user2ActionedAt.description: Timestamp when user2 last interacted with this match (e.g., liked or rejected).

isMutual.description: Indicates if both users have mutually accepted each other, leading to an active conversation possibility.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this match record was initially created or suggested.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: Represents a one-on-one chat conversation between two matched users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Conversation entity.

participantIds.description: An array containing the IDs of the two UserProfiles participating in this conversation.

lastMessageContent.description: The content of the most recent message in the conversation.

lastMessageSenderId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who sent the last message.

lastMessageSentAt.description: Timestamp when the last message in the conversation was sent.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the conversation was initiated.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the conversation was last updated.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message sent within a conversation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

conversationId.description: Reference to the Conversation this message belongs to.

senderId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who sent this message.

content.description: The actual text content of the message.

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

readBy.description: An array of UserProfile IDs who have read this message.

VerificationRequest.title: VerificationRequest
VerificationRequest.description: Stores details about a user's identity verification submission, including references to uploaded documents.

id.description: Unique identifier for the VerificationRequest entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile for whom this verification request was submitted.

idCardFrontUrl.description: URL to the front side of the user's identification card.

idCardBackUrl.description: URL to the back side of the user's identification card.

selfieUrl.description: URL to the user's selfie photo.

status.description: The current status of the verification request. (enum: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected').

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the verification request was submitted.

reviewedAt.description: Timestamp when the verification request was reviewed (optional).

reviewerId.description: Reference to the admin or moderator UserProfile who reviewed this request.

rejectionReason.description: A textual explanation if the verification request was rejected.
